purpose: Dedicated defense workshop UI revision after user rejected reused buttons, slider, typography and palette.
button:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single production-ready raster button skin for a Korean tactical co-op monster defense game's squad workshop.
Primary request: brand new dedicated mechanical command button. ONE blank horizontal button, no words, no icons, no letters. Wide landscape canvas approximately 3:1. True transparent background. The button fills almost the entire canvas, with only 3% transparent margin on each side.
Design: premium clean industrial design, a solid pale ivory ceramic face in a very thin graphite machined metal housing. Straight horizontal top/bottom, precisely clipped small corners. Two restrained cyan illuminated inserts on the extreme left and right. A tiny seam, two understated fasteners. Subtle tactile material and lighting, crisp silhouette at small screen size. Center 75% must be smooth and quiet for dark HTML text overlay.
Camera: orthographic directly face-on; no perspective tilt, no floor.
Palette: neutral graphite, ivory #eeefe9, cold cyan #72dce9. No warm metal, gold, bronze, green, fantasy jewelry, wings, scrollwork, bevel stacks, spiky frames, runes, arrows, slider knob, additional buttons or layout. Keep the button simple and decisive, not ornate.
Constraints: transparent background; preserve alpha; no baked-in text or shadows far outside the edge; no UI screenshot.
background:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide environment illustration background for a premium monster-defense squad workshop UI.
Primary request: an original high-quality tactical field-service bay, restrained, clean, sophisticated industrial science-fiction art. Wide 16:9 composition. Empty recessed equipment alcove at center, large matte graphite architectural panels, a few slim cyan status lights, one ivory steel frame at left, a distant sealed equipment rack at right. Grounded painted 3D game environment finish, clean precise geometry and subtle wear. No people, no weapons, no floating UI.
Composition: symmetrical broad negative space in the middle 70% for foreground machine art and legible interface overlays. Most structure and detail near the outer left/right edges; center remains smooth charcoal. Soft neutral overhead light, gentle cyan light only at lower seams. Readable tonal depth, not flat black, no exaggerated bloom, no fog curtain.
Palette: neutral charcoal #171d24, graphite #262f38, soft ivory hardware and subdued cyan. Do not use the green-and-bronze palette. No gold, brown, fantasy cathedral, arches, crystals, glowing rings, filigree, gothic ornaments, magical workshop, embedded lettering, interface panels, buttons, logos or watermark.
This is an environment-only original raster asset, not a full UI screenshot.
